meta_title: Aporta · Housing and city guide for Benjamin Constant
meta_description: Houses, apartments, studios, rooms and hotels in Benjamin Constant, with direct WhatsApp contact with the owner, plus a city guide for new arrivals.
footer_tagline: Where to live and what to do in Benjamin Constant, straight from the people who own the place.
footer_credit: Made in Benjamin Constant, in the Alto Solimões.

hero_title: Find a place to live in Benjamin Constant
hero_lead: Houses, studios, rooms and hotels, straight from the owner on WhatsApp. For anyone arriving to study, work or see the city.
hero_cta_search: I am looking for a place
hero_cta_owner: I have a place to list
hero_scene_label: Wooden houses over the river, seen from the bank
trust_title: No lost groups, no price surprises
trust_direct_text: One tap opens the WhatsApp chat with the listing name already written. There is no middleman and no sign-up for people searching.
trust_verified_title: Verified owner and an up-to-date ad
trust_verified_text: Every ad shows when it was last updated. A stale ad often means the place is already rented, and we keep that in plain sight.
trust_clear_text: Water, electricity and internet are either in the price or not, and the card says so before you open the ad. Anything not included shows as "paid by you".
guide_band_text: Where to eat, where to drink, what is on this weekend, and where the bank, pharmacy and port are. Includes the boi-bumbá festival.
owner_band_title: Graduated and left a place empty?
owner_band_text: List the house or studio in a few minutes and talk to people searching, without relying on WhatsApp groups.
listings_page_description: Filter by price, neighborhood and period and talk straight to the owner.
listings_empty_description: Remove a filter or clear the search to see available listings.
whatsapp_message: Hello! I saw the listing "{title}" ({neighborhood}) on Aporta and I am interested. Is it still available?
guide_page_description: Where to eat, drink, what is on and the useful services in Benjamin Constant.
guide_lead: A few places, chosen on purpose, for people who just arrived.
guide_empty_title: No places in this tab yet
guide_empty_description: We are filling in the guide little by little. Check the other tabs in the meantime.
guide_whatsapp_message: Hello! I saw {name} in the Aporta guide.
owner_page_description: Register your house, studio, room or hotel in a few steps and talk to people searching.
owner_lead: Six short steps. What you write is saved on this device, so you can leave to take the photos and come back later.
tip_photo_facade: The front of the house, head on and in daylight.
tip_photo_bedroom: The whole bedroom, not just the bed.
tip_photo_bathroom: The bathroom, with the shower in view.
tip_photo_light: Open the windows: photos in natural light build more trust.
tip_values_included: Tick what is already in the rent: water, electricity and internet.
tip_values_honest: A clear price saves wasted chats: people compare by price.
field_address_hint: Only shown once a visitor opens the listing.
field_monthly_hint: Numbers only. Hotels: the equivalent of one month.
field_daily_hint: Fill in if you rent by the day.
field_included: What is included in the rent
field_minimum_hint: A semester is usually 4 to 6 months.
field_rules_hint: One per line: pets, visitors, quiet hours, schedule.
field_whatsapp_hint: With area code, numbers only. This is where chats arrive.
owner_ready_text: "{title}" was sent and is under review. Once the team approves it, the listing shows up for people searching. The draft on this device was deleted.

auth_sign_up_lead: With an account you list your property and talk directly to people looking for a place.

photos_step_lead: Pick the photos of the property and say what each one shows. A listing with the facade, bedroom, bathroom and kitchen builds more trust.
